title: Mixed Event — Let's Study Hard! — Episode1 Terrifying News

meta.Event Outline: The end of the year is approaching at Kamiyama High School. An is headed to practice as usual when a teacher stops her and Mizuki in their tracks. That's when the pair are confronted with some hair-raising news about their prospects for the next school year.

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
All done for the day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I better get ready to leave so I don't keep Kohane waiting!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hahaha! An, you always get so happy the second school is out.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You're right. It's like the joy of freedom from the classroom floods her whole being.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean? It's a totally normal reaction, thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, don't you guys have club to get to? The second years won't be happy if you keep dawdling.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh my gosh, you're right! See you tomorrow, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you! Good luck with club!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's time for me to get going. What was it again that we're practicing today?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hiya, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: C'mon, don't jump out at me like that. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Do you wanna walk home together today? Someone I know told me about this place with amazing apple pies!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're supposed to have amazing texture! Soft on the inside and crispy on the outside! Plus, the filling is really sweet, and they're not stingy with it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, that does sound good...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, sorry! I have singing practice with the others today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, really? Oh well then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry. But thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, you're fine. Let's hang out another—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Shiraishi. Akiyama. May I have a word?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes? What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: There's something we need to discuss. Follow me.
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Here should be fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, so what is it you need to “discuss”?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Since you took us all the way here...
I'm guessing it's something you don't want the whole world hearing?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Well, yes...
Shiraishi. Do you remember how you did on the tests we had the other day?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I, um... Well...
I don't think my grades were high, exactly...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But, I'm sure they weren't all low! Like, home ec...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Home ec...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah! And I didn't fail math either!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It's true that you achieved good results for math this time. However... What about classics and chemistry?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, well... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A-Anyway! Was there a problem with my test results?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Shiraishi... You are a high schooler now.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You need to show that you have the academic ability of one to advance to second year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! Y-You don't mean—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Starting Monday, you'll be going to supplementary classes for a week.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
S-S-Su...
Supplementary classes?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But, no! You've gotta be kidding!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, supplementary classes...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I am not kidding! This is no laughing matter.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Rules are rules.
If you don't score high enough on tests, we have to fail you.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That said, we teachers don't want any of you to be held back. We'll be giving you supplementary classes specifically in order to prevent that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Now that we're clear on that...
I expect you to show up every day on time, starting on Monday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ahaha... That sure sucks, An.
But, it'll be worth the hard work to make sure you go into second year.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: What's this Akiyama? It looks like the pot is calling the kettle black.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You're taking those supplementary classes too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Wh-Wh-Why?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But, my test scores were totally fine, weren't they?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, I can't deny your academic achievement. The issue is your attendance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No no no! I did a ton of worksheets the other day 'cause I was told it would make up for my low attendance!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, you did.
However, you had a string of absences after that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's true...
But, I made sure they were all days that it would be okay to skip and—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(...? Hang on...
Didn't the teacher get sick one time, and math got swapped with English the next day...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Wait. If that's true, then...
My English attendance is—)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It seems I've jogged your memory?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh... Umm... Well...
Yes...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Well then, have I made myself clear?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Shiraishi. Akiyama. I expect you both to attend all of next week's supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An & Mizuki
rows.Line: N-Nooo!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...and, so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, you guys!
I have to take supplementary classes all next week!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I really am sorry!
I've gotta stay back after school every day to study...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, I promise I'll practice as soon as I get home!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It can't be helped.
Being held back would be terrible...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Have you talked to your dad yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
He told me to knuckle down and study hard so I don't get held back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, there's nothing for me to say. If there's anything I can do to help, let me know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good luck, An!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't really know much about school...
But I'll do anything I can to support you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me too, me too!
I'll make you lots of tasty coffee to keep you energized!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good idea. I'll make lots of sweet snacks for you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I guess it's just going to be the three of you at practice until An finishes her supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. Akito, Azusawa, let's just do what we can for now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Come to think of it, Akito, you're oddly quiet today. Is something up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito. Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: ...too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I...have supplementary classes too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You too, Shinonome...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, why didn't you say so?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-I see... Akito and An, we're rooting for both of you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'd be a disaster if neither of you got to go into second year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... So Akito's taking supplementary classes too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, that checks out.
It'd be crazy if I had to take supplementary classes but not you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?! What's that supposed to mean? I'm smarter than you, and—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What? No you're not.
I only failed two subjects.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The same as me, then. And for the record, I scored higher than you in world history.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what? In math, I—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-Both of you, please calm down...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Pointlessly arguing over such things changes nothing about the fact that you both failed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The important thing now is for you both to make the most of the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Point taken.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Toya's right...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (These classes are going to be tough, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've gotta study hard and make sure I get into second year!)
